name: HYPERFRAMES
summary: Write HTML, render deterministic MP4 video: plan the video, author HTML compositions with data-* timing attributes, wire seekable animations (GSAP/Lottie/CSS/Three.js), add media, lint, preview, and render — built for coding agents.
prevents: Agents guessing at video authoring patterns — non-seekable animations, misaligned timing, non-deterministic renders, and broken FFmpeg pipelines.

cursor.rule_description: Use when the task involves creating, editing, or rendering any video, animation, or motion graphic using HyperFrames HTML compositions.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar HYPERFRAMES — HTML-to-MP4 production loop: plan → write HTML composition → seekable animations → media → lint → preview → render. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-hyperframes or asks to make a video.
